title: Megacles the Archon
summary: Raleigh names Megacles the Archon in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Megacles, named among the annuall Magistrates of Athens between Draco and Solon. He is not the Megacles who headed a faction in Athens after Solon his lawes were broken. The one-word title would fold onto that Megacles, so the title is three words. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.
